title: Massage After Breast Augmentation: When to Start, How Often
meta_description: Only if your surgeon prescribes it: no guideline sets a start date or schedule, and a 2017 review doesn't support it for contracture. Back massages too.
excerpt: Some surgeons prescribe implant massage and many don't, and a 2017 review found the data don't support it for preventing capsular contracture. Here is what the evidence says, how the four kinds of massage differ, and when to ask about a back massage.
quick_answer:
How often should you massage your breasts after augmentation?

Only as often as your surgeon prescribes, and only if they do. No society or university handout gives a start date or schedule. A 2017 literature review of 4 studies found the data don't support massage to prevent capsular contracture. A back massage waits until you can lie on your front, so ask your surgeon.
